about: SCION 07 (Foldès) asset ledger. Every visible and audible element of film.mp4 is listed. No pixels from any source image are in the film; the one archive frame below was looked at (with its SAM outline) to set the dog's proportions, then the dog was drawn as coordinates.

assets.what: reference only: one frame of the archive dog in profile, head low, with its SAM mask outline, viewed to read proportions (body length about 1.2x withers height, deep chest, long legs, low bushy tail)
assets.path: paeleo/handmade/kit/archive-dog/frames/f008.jpg (+ masks.json key '8'); also looked at f000, f020, f040
assets.operation: studied (looked at); not traced, cropped or copied. No pixel of it is in the film.

assets.what: the dog: 16 body key drawings (stand, crouch, lie, curl, rear 3/4, rear, front 3/4, front, and their mirrors) and 10 head key drawings (profile, 3/4 front, front, 3/4 rear, rear, and mirrors); named strokes with fixed point counts (the correspondences)
assets.source_title: drawn by this swarm (SCION 07) as coordinates
assets.operation: drawn (hand-authored contour coordinates), mirrored with left/right swapped for the far side

assets.what: the person: 8 key drawings (stand, call, reach with the arm drawn long, side step, lowering, sit, low hand, soft)

house front, doorway with trim and a raised sill, door leaf with panels, window, interior with a lamp and a picture, porch boards, railing, posts, steps, roof beam, dusk sky gradient, tree line, moon, paper grain
assets.operation: drawn (ruled and splined contours with flat washes; numpy paper grain)

assets.what: the door leaf's outline carried out of the doorway and laid on the boards as the light pool (corner correspondences leaf -> pool)

voices (formant synthesis: 'Come here.' twice, raised; 'It's all right.' twice and 'Come in.', soft and breathy), pen scratch following the drawing's change, paw ticks at each planted step, door latch and creak, sighs, tail thumps, a warm chord for the light, dusk room tone and crickets
fonts for the title card, end card and the person's spoken words
assets.path: tools/paeleo/fonts/f5.woff2 (Big Shoulders Display 800), f14.woff2 (JetBrains Mono), f27.woff2 / f34.woff2 (Literata)
assets.rights: SIL Open Font License (these Google Fonts families are OFL; no licence file sits in tools/paeleo/fonts, so this is from the family's known licence, not a file in the repo)

assets.what: the dog's decision trace (states, x, acting intentions; the person's circumstances and the door)
assets.operation: read; drives the schedule, position, ears, tail, wag, person and door timing

not_used: Quick, Draw! drawings, the archive door, the 98 found shots, stage.js and lenses.js were not used.
